caveat: When operated in FIPS mode with bound module Juniper OpenSSL Cryptographic Module validated to FIPS 140-2 under Cert. #4131 operating in FIPS mode. The module generates random strings whose strengths are modified by available entropy
description: The Juniper Kernel Cryptographic Module is a software module running as part of the operating system kernel that provides general purpose cryptographic services.
